definitions.explanation: A wide, well-traveled street that is the primary thoroughfare in an area, as opposed to back streets or side streets.

examples.japanese: {表通|おもてどお}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{面|めん}した→面する：14629_mensuru⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧。
examples.english: A shop facing the main street.

examples.japanese: {表通|おもてどお}り⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{人通|ひとどお}り⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: There is a lot of foot traffic on the main street.

examples.japanese: {表通|おもてどお}り⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{一本|いっぽん}→一本：08888_ippon⟧⟦{入|はい}った→入る：00494_hairu⟧⟦{路地|ろじ}→路地：06501_roji⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{隠|かく}れた→隠れる：02035_kakureru⟧⟦{名店|めいてん}→名店：21511_meiten⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There's a hidden gem of a restaurant in an alley one block off the main street.

notes:
USAGE:
Contrasts with ⟦{裏通|うらどお}り→裏通り：09383_uradoori⟧ (back street, side street). Properties facing the {表通|おもてどお}り tend to have higher rent and more visibility.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {表通|おもてどお}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{面|めん}する→面する：14629_mensuru⟧ (to face the main street)
- {表通|おもてどお}り{沿|ぞ}い (along the main street)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{裏通|うらどお}り→裏通り：09383_uradoori⟧: back street — a quieter, narrower side street behind the main road
- ⟦{大通|おおどお}り→大通り：26913_oodoori⟧: wide avenue — a major boulevard, often wider than {表通|おもてどお}り
